Class ScoreEntry

java.lang.Object
com.comp2042.LeaderBoard.ScoreEntry
public class ScoreEntry extends Object
Represents a single entry in the leaderboard.

Each entry stores the player's name, score, game mode, and the timestamp when the score was recorded. The score is wrapped in an IntegerProperty to support JavaFX property binding.

      public ScoreEntry(String playerName, javafx.beans.property.IntegerProperty score, String gameMode)
      Constructs a ScoreEntry with the given player name, score property, and game mode. If the provided score property is null, a default score of 0 is used.
      Parameters:
      playerName - the name of the player
      score - the score property (nullable)
      gameMode - the game mode in which the score was achieved

    • getMode

      public String getMode()
      Retrieves the game mode associated with this score entry.

      This method acts as the standard getter for the "mode" property, ensuring compatibility with the PropertyValueFactory used in the JavaFX TableColumn.

      Returns:
      the game mode (e.g., "Sprint", "Marathon","Ultrs") as a string

    • getGameMode

      public String getGameMode()
      Retrieves the internal game mode field.

      This method is retained for compatibility with existing internal code that may reference the gameMode field directly. It serves the same function as getMode().

      Returns:
      the game mode as a string
